instrument: Alcor System ALPHEA 6CW All Sky Camera; ZWO ASI178MC + 1.55mm fisheye lens
notes: Initial Lulin all-sky estimate. Confirm cx/cy/radius with estimate-circle, then refine rotation_deg with identified stars.
